notes: Layout 3D: M is a move tool like SketchUp. The arrow keys pick the axis (→ X red, ← Y green, ↑ Z blue, ↓ free) and the pieces turn that color. Type a distance like 2, -1.5 or 3 1/4 and press Enter. Dragging stays on the axis. Esc ends the tool. The Rotate window stays open so you can keep turning. Layout: a piece selected on the pieces side is outlined there again.
